# Jeff Slavin | Lead Technical Writer

> Documentation portfolio of Jeff Slavin: 10+ years across API, cloud, edge, IoT, and DevSecOps documentation, focused on information architecture, Docs as Code, OpenAPI, and content structured for self-service and AI retrieval.

Headline outcomes: cut migration support tickets by 30%, took partner integrations from weeks to days through the OpenAPI documentation behind SDK generation, improved search success by 60% with a Confluence-to-self-service portal redesign, and authored design documentation for a secure AWS edge platform whose rollout cut retail client hardware costs by 40%.

Each page linked below is also served as clean Markdown at its URL plus index.md. The complete Markdown content of this site is exported at [llms-full.txt](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/llms-full.txt), regenerated on every build. An agent instruction file for working with this content is at [skill.md](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/skill.md).

## Pages

- [Home](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/index.md): positioning, specialties, headline metrics, and certifications
- [Portfolio](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/portfolio/index.md): ten samples across GitOps and DevSecOps, API and developer, end-user onboarding, and edge computing documentation, plus public contribution evidence
- [Resume](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/resume/index.md): full work history and skills ([PDF version](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/assets/Jeff-Slavin-Resume.pdf))

## Writing samples

- [NovaDeploy GitOps Administration Guide - Portfolio Cut](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/writing-samples/novadeploy-gitops-admin-guide-portfolio-cut/index.md): a 5-7-minute cut of a fictional operator runbook for deploying services to Amazon EKS with Argo CD, covering the deployment path and stop checkpoints
- [NovaDeploy GitOps Administration Guide - Full Runbook](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/writing-samples/novadeploy-gitops-admin-guide-full-version/index.md): the complete fictional runbook spanning EKS, IAM, KMS, External Secrets Operator, Reloader, CI guardrails, verification, and rollback

NovaDeploy is a fictional platform: both samples are original demonstration writing and contain no employer or client information. Live production documentation Jeff authored (ClearBlade API references, quick start, webhooks, and edge guides) is linked from the [Portfolio](https://jslavin-docs.github.io/portfolio/) page.
